question: Can an external tokenless learner infer previously unknown four-vertex causal edge incidence and response-channel offsets from eight noisy interventions, and does enforcing a globally coherent learned cycle improve structure recovery without falsely claiming discovery of arbitrary new topologies?
hypothesis: One targeted Pass B correction (joint global cycle MAP over candidate unknown edge assignments) lowers Brier at least 15% against Pass A independent MAP, stays within 10% of exact correct-family cycle Bayes Brier, and does not reduce exact edge+offset recovery rate. Strong exact unrestricted graph Bayes is retained as a check on inductive bias. If it fails, stop this variant after two bounded development passes.

predecessor_evidence.note: YNCA08 learned to filter the obstruction from a manually supplied constant F2 sheaf; did not learn the sheaf incidence itself
YNCA05 established information ceilings from insufficient interventions; this experiment acquires action-consequence evidence for previously unlabeled edge structure
CKAD cumulative native learner separate, not modified

inputs.name: Synthetic four-vertex causal graph, four anonymous noisy binary response channels, eight per-world independent uniform binary vertex interventions
inputs.source: External source-free deterministic Python stdlib generator. No native Yggdrasil world model, protected holdout, private original data or paid API.

pass_A.status: Exploratory executed locally before prereg; not confirmatory
pass_A.diagnosis: Independent edge maximum likelihood ignores evidence that every response channel must belong to a different edge of a single connected cycle. One pre-registered correction is joint cycle-constrained MAP.

pass_B.status: Unseen, not executed before prereg/source lock
pass_B.interventions: Eight uniform hash-seeded 4-bit vertex interventions/world, four noisy anonymous edge response channels per action
pass_B.outcome: All 16 intervention assignments and four channels scored after inference, never exposed to policy; fixed 64-bit evaluation target/world
pass_B.source: Freeze source Git SHA and SHA-256 before first B run; result separately archived and compared across Linux + Windows.

shift_holdout.status: RESERVED; do NOT run in this gate unless an independent protocol authorizes it
shift_holdout.topologies: Noncycle 4-edge connected graph (triangle with attached vertex), outside cycle-only B's structural grammar; expected falsification

frozen_design.grammar: Four labelled vertex binary action bits; 6 candidate unordered XOR edges; 4 unknown distinct response-channel edges and 4 independent unknown edge-bit offsets. Train/A/B graphs drawn from all three unlabeled four-cycles. Candidate B includes cycle topology and channel permutation, selected by joint maximum likelihood on noisy consequence observations. No hidden evaluation truth enters prediction.
controls: Independent per-channel maximum likelihood over all 6 edges x 2 offsets (Pass A)
Independent per-channel full Bayesian mixture over all edges and offsets
Exact Bayesian graph+offset posterior over 3 four-cycle topologies and all channel permutations
Exact Bayesian graph+offset posterior over all 15 distinct 4-edge connected topologies and channel permutations
frozen_design.evaluator: 64 channel/action truth bits/world. Brier and 0.5-threshold channel accuracy; exact edge-and-offset assignment accuracy; source/runtime receipts. All inference sees the same eight noisy four-channel observations. Calibrations at 10% independent bit noise; held-out truth never used for fitting.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python 3.12 standard library, GitHub hosted Linux and Windows <=12 min/job, no GPUs, no paid APIs, no native owner runner
frozen_design.capacity: 4 binary vertices, 4 anonymous channels, 6 potential XOR edges, up to 15 topology families, no increasing model parameters or new primitive operations across B cohorts
frozen_design.possible_shift_limit: The graph cycle relation is supplied as a prior; this is wiring discovery inside a fixed algebraic family, not autonomous invention of a new relation or learned sheaf restriction maps.
frozen_design.frozen_source_before_B: source commit and file SHA-256 to be appended to prereg before B workflow first use

controls: Independent exact Bayesian posterior over 12 edge/offset pairs
Exact Bayes uniform prior over correct four-cycle graph family with unknown channel mapping and edge offsets
Exact Bayes over all 15 connected four-edge graph topologies
metrics: Mean full 16-action four-channel Brier score lower better
Brier change versus A and ratio to exact cycle Bayes
Linux/Windows original-result hash and 6+ focused negative controls
Offline model posterior/sampling operation counts; wallclock if available

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL if corrected joint-cycle MAP Brier <=0.85x independent-MAP Brier, Brier <=1.10x exact cycle Bayes, and edge-plus-offset identification accuracy >= independent-MAP; all sources frozen before independent B and exact output matches OS. This does NOT demonstrate SCIENTIFIC_PASS, native transfer or novel operators.
classification_rules.mixed: Joint MAP reduces Brier and raises correct edge recovery, but misses exact-Bayes proximity/15% threshold: DEVELOPMENT_MIXED, preserve progress but do not tune this candidate further on B.
classification_rules.negative: Joint MAP is worse than independent MAP or fails key recovery/accuracy checks; DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. Stop after bounded A+B instead of tuning B.
classification_rules.invalid: B or SHIFT outcomes inspected before source prereg lock; loss of source/hash identity; inconsistent OS result; hidden edge labels supplied to fitted policy; omitted exact Bayes; post-result threshold edits or unseen additional models.

prohibited_after_primary_run: use reserved SHIFT to salvage B negative
change source or thresholds and call the new run original B
promote external contributor evidence to accepted native learning
claim fixed cycle prior is autonomously generated by learner
modify CKAD, owner, controller, scheduler, accepted refs or deployments
preregistration_note: A exploratory local inspection is disclosed. B candidate source will be pinned and executed only once per OS on disjoint worlds. The user allows one targeted development correction, not unlimited tuning.
